name: Danno's Ibiza West
description: Danno's is a lively karaoke venue known for its welcoming atmosphere and friendly staff. It offers a fun, small-town bar experience with a DJ and light show that encourages dancing and singing along. The venue features a good selection of food and drinks, including affordable burger specials on Tuesdays. Its cozy, dive-bar vibe makes it a popular spot for both casual singing and lively nights out, with a focus on community and fun.
